subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete
stimulus: sentence. There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. Nobody can make progress and prosperity i. life and speed if there is no sort of the in life competition b. Life itself loses its interest and speed ii. the keener the contest the greater the enjoyment c. Similarly, games and sports grow departed iii. type of continuous appetitive of examination d. A victory is not meaningful and significant iv. if the result can queasily foreseen unless e. Human life is indeed one v. without the exercise of struggle vi. in the absence of sincere efforts vii. and until both sides are equally matched
guide_solution: (a + v) : Nobody can make progress and prosperity in life without the exercise of struggle. (b + vi) : Life itself loses its interest and speed in the absence of sincere efforts. (c + i) : Similarly, games and sports grow departed of life and speed if there is no sort of the competition. (d + vii) : A victory is not meaningful and significant unless and until both sides are equally matched. (e + iii) : Human life is indeed one type of continuous appetitive examination.
